name: Manzherok
full: Manzherok is a village on the Katun by the Chuysky Trakt (Maima district) and the year-round resort of the same name at the foot of Mount Malaya Sinyukha (resort address: Ozernoye village, Kurort Manzherok, bldg 1), with Lake Manzherok nearby
near: Manzherok, Ozernoye; Gorno-Altaysk ~20–30 km, Gorno-Altaysk airport (GRV) ~26 km
elev: Lake 373 m; upper station of the Chuysky Trakt gondola ~1020 m (drop of 633 m); summit of Malaya Sinyukha ~1200–1240 m
short: The biggest year-round resort in the Altai Mountains: Siberia's longest gondola up Malaya Sinyukha, ski runs, a spa and 3–5* hotels, and below it the warm Lake Manzherok with water chestnut and a beach.
desc: The village of Manzherok has been known since Soviet times (the song “Manzherok” and the friendship festival of the 1960s), and since the 2010s the year-round Manzherok resort has been growing on the slopes of Mount Malaya Sinyukha. Five lifts run all year; the main one is the Chuysky Trakt gondola, 2516 m long with a 633 m drop (8–12 min ride up), plus the Voskhod, Sofia, Lednik and Karusel chairlifts and a travelator. In winter (≈mid-November to mid-April) there are about 50 km of runs; in summer there are sightseeing lift rides, eco trails of the Keeper of the Great Altai theme park, viewpoints, paragliding, a bike park and restaurants on the mountain. The resort has the Manzherok 5* and Manzherok 3* hotels and a spa complex with pools. 2 km from the village is Lake Manzherok (1.1×0.4 km, up to 3 m deep), a former oxbow of the Katun; in summer it warms up to +21…22 °C, and it has a free beach and catamaran and SUP rental. The lake is a natural monument because of the Red Data Book water chestnut (chilim, Trapa natans), and it has been cleared of silt since 2018. In 2026 a bypass of the Chuysky Trakt (km 454–475, with an interchange at the turn to Ozernoye) is under construction near Manzherok, due to finish at the end of 2028.
guide: Take the Chuysky Trakt gondola up Malaya Sinyukha on a clear day: from the top you can see the Katun winding between the ridges, and Lake Manzherok looks like a green drop. Down below, be sure to visit the lake — in summer it is one of the few mountain lakes in Altai where you can swim without an icy shock; look for rosettes of water chestnut, a Red Data Book plant, near the shore. If you're on a budget, stay at a guesthouse in the village of Manzherok or Ozernoye and buy food there, coming to the resort only for the cable car. Everyone here knows the 1960s song “Manzherok” — ask the locals where the name comes from.
see: The gondola ride up Malaya Sinyukha and the viewpoints; the eco trails of the Keeper of the Great Altai park; Lake Manzherok (beach, water chestnut, catamarans, SUPs); the Katun by the village; nearby: Cheremshanka Waterfall (~9 km), Emurla Waterfall, Patmos Island in Chemal, Kamyshla Waterfall.
skip: You are going to Altai for wild nature and quiet: Manzherok is a developed resort with hotels, construction and crowds, and the Chuysky Trakt next to it is under reconstruction in 2026–2028.
diff: Easy: the cable car is accessible to everyone; the eco trails on the mountain are easy/moderate; the runs range from green to black.
when: Skiing: mid-November to mid-April (best January–March); summer: July–August (swimming in the lake); autumn: September (colors). The cable cars run all year.
hours: Cable cars 9:00–18:00, last boarding 17:00; they do not run in wind over 15 m/s, thunderstorms, or frost below −25 °C (kp.ru, 2026). Lake beach 10:00–21:00 (kp.ru).
daytime: Morning: be first on the gondola, before the clouds and queues arrive (editorial); sunset: at the lake.
how: Fly to Gorno-Altaysk (GRV), then 26 km/30–40 min along the Chuysky Trakt (transfer ~8500 ₽ per car via Sputnik8). From Novosibirsk by bus 8–9.5 h; or by train to Biysk and then along the trakt. From Gorno-Altaysk ~35–40 min by car; according to kp.ru, bus No. 132 (≈1 h). To the resort, turn off to Ozernoye, 4 km from Manzherok; free parking. In 2026–2028 the bypass of the trakt (km 454–475, Souzga — Manzherok) is under construction.
needcar: Yes, to reach the resort (taxi/transfer/car/bus); inside the resort everything is on foot.
roadtype: Paved road (Chuysky Trakt R256 + the access road to Ozernoye); in 2026 there are construction sections with detours.
traveltime: GRV airport — resort 30–40 min; Gorno-Altaysk — 35–40 min; Novosibirsk — 8–9.5 h by bus; gondola ride up 8–12 min.
stay: At the resort: Manzherok 5* — from ~29,800–32,000 ₽/night, Manzherok 3* — from ~24,000 ₽ (travelto/kp, 2025–2026); the resort's overall range is 4800–126,000 ₽ (Altapress, 06.2026). In the villages of Manzherok/Ozernoye — guesthouses and bases 2500–7000 ₽ (kp.ru, travelto, 2026).
net: Resort and villages by the trakt — mobile signal and Wi-Fi in hotels (operators not specified).
entry: Entry to the resort grounds and the lake beach is free (kp.ru). Cable cars are paid (sightseeing ride from 1500 ₽). There is no resort tax in the Altai Republic.
transfer: Airport — Manzherok 8500 ₽ per car (Sputnik8); excursions from Manzherok from 2200 ₽ (kp.ru).
bring: A windbreaker/warm sweater for the summit (it is cooler 600 m higher), sun protection, a swimsuit in summer, tick repellent for the eco trails.
warn: Construction of the Chuysky Trakt bypass (km 454–475) until the end of 2028 — traffic jams and detours; repairs at km 455–472 and 479–495 in 2026. Cable cars close in strong wind/thunderstorms. Eco trails are sometimes closed because of bears (Yandex reviews). Ticks: April to August.
food: Resort restaurants (including a restaurant on the mountain; average bill ~700–1500 ₽, Gornaya ~1500 ₽ per person — Altapress 2026), dishes from local farm produce; groceries are cheaper in the shops in Ozernoye.
reviews: Yandex Maps (resort): 5.0, 20,047 ratings, 6592 reviews (10.2026). Pros: modern infrastructure, spa, cable cars, eco trails, breakfasts. Cons: high prices, uneven service, construction, overcrowded spa at peak times.

p.sum: The easiest spot in Altai: 30–40 minutes from Gorno-Altaysk airport along the trakt. The resort has a gondola up Malaya Sinyukha, eco trails, a spa and 3–5* hotels, with a free beach on the warm Lake Manzherok nearby. On a budget: stay in the village and come only for the cable car.
